name: cups
description: CUPS print server with USB printer access and a browser-based admin interface

fields.name: CUPS_PORT
fields.label: R1: App Port
fields.help: Host port used to open the CUPS web interface in your browser.

fields.name: CUPS_CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R2: CUPS Config Folder
fields.help: Stores CUPS configuration under this app's EasyDocker project folder.

fields.name: CUPS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
fields.label: R3: Admin Password
fields.help: Password for the CUPS admin user. Change this from the default before exposing CUPS beyond a trusted local network.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O2: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: CUPS_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help:
Docker image used for CUPS.
Change this only if you want a different tag or image source.

fields.name: CUPS_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: CUPS_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal App Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed CUPS internal web interface port.

fields.name: CUPS_DBUS_LOCATION
fields.label: Host D-Bus Socket Folder
fields.help: Recipe-managed host D-Bus path used by printer services.

fields.name: CUPS_USB_BUS_LOCATION
fields.label: Host USB Bus Folder
fields.help: Recipe-managed host USB bus path used for USB printers.

fields.name: CUPS_PRIVILEGED
fields.label: Privileged Mode
fields.help: Recipe-managed privileged mode required for USB printer access.

ui.overview: CUPS provides a local print server web interface and passes host USB printer access into Docker.
what_happens: CUPS runs in privileged mode so it can access USB printers that may appear anywhere under /dev/bus/usb
The host USB bus and D-Bus paths are mounted into the container for printer discovery and communication
Access the CUPS web interface using HTTPS on the configured port
Administrative pages and printer configuration will not be accessible unless you use HTTPS
ui.data_location: Relative paths are stored inside this app's project folder under the mounted EasyDocker base config path.
